name: Bidirectional Sphere Tracing
definition: A surface extraction technique that uses bidirectional sphere tracing to narrow the possible range of surface positions, then refines the zero-level set using additional solvers, mitigating convergence issues of standard sphere tracing when rays miss surface edges or surfaces are not orthogonal to the ray.
summary: Bidirectional sphere tracing is a robust surface extraction technique that uses forward and backward traces to define a bounded search interval, replacing iterative heuristics to mitigate convergence failures.
